description: Edit one manufacturing order, named by id (GUID) or number. Every omitted field keeps its value; an empty description or internal note clears it. A draft takes every field: priority (1 highest to 10 lowest), assignee, customer, internal production warehouse, planned start and completion days (YYYY-MM-DD), description, internal note, and lines, which replace every existing line (1–50, each an item, that item's own bill of materials and a positive quantity). Once issued, only priority, planned days, description and internal note can change; completed and canceled orders cannot be edited. Assignee, customer, warehouse and planned days can be changed but not cleared. Custom fields are left alone. Preview first; it lists each field that changes. Requires Write + manufacturing.execute on an unpinned operator credential. In-app assistants get a confirm card the user applies.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

manufacturingOrder.description: The manufacturing order: its id (GUID) or its number, e.g. MO-001.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.
